items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the flatness criterion at the associated points of the fibre at source lines 834-850, label theorem-check-flatness-at-associated-points, whose proof occupies source lines 852-887. The proof reduces the statement to the scheme case through etale charts, and the reduction is where the content lies: the associated points of the fibre of the pulled back module must be identified with the fibre of the associated points of the original module, and one must check that the hypothesis is inherited, which uses continuity of the map on underlying spaces to compare specializations. The converse direction is not automatic and needs decentness: the image point is represented by a quasi-compact monomorphism, the fibre is identified as the fibre product over the residue field, the fibre of a decent morphism is decent, and specializations lift along the chart, which is what allows the scheme case to be applied backwards. The counted statement records neither the chart reduction nor the decentness input.
